scripts.title: Noclip Script For Any Game
scripts.features: Noclip in any game
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local noclip = false

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then
		noclip = not noclip
		print("Noclip:", noclip and "ON" or "OFF")
	end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
	if not player.Character then return end

	for _, part in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = not noclip
		end
	end
end)

local function normalizeId(raw)
    raw = (raw or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
    if raw == "" then return nil end
    if tonumber(raw) then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. raw
    end
    if raw:match("^rbxassetid://") then return raw end
    if raw:match("^https?://") then
        local id = raw:match("(%d+)")
        if id then return "rbxassetid://" .. id end
    end
    return raw
end

local function ensureSound()
    if state.sound and state.sound.Parent then return state.sound end
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.Name = "BoomboxSound"
    s.Looped = state.looped
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Parent = SoundService
    state.sound = s
    return s
end

local function stopSound()
    if state.sound then
        state.sound:Stop()
        state.sound:Destroy()
        state.sound = nil
    end
    state.playing = false
end

local function playSound()
    if state.soundId == "" then
        setStatus("Enter a music id first.")
        return
    end
    stopSound()
    local s = ensureSound()
    s.SoundId = state.soundId
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Looped = state.looped
    local ok, err = pcall(function() s:Play() end)
    if not ok then
        setStatus("Playback failed.")
        return
    end
    state.playing = true
    setStatus("Playing.")
end

local function pauseSound()
    if state.sound and state.playing then
        state.sound:Pause()
        state.playing = false
        setStatus("Paused.")
    end
end

local function resumeSound()
    if state.sound and not state.playing then
        state.sound:Resume()
        state.playing = true
        setStatus("Resumed.")

end

local function addStyle(name, formatter)
	table.insert(styles, {
		Name = name,
		Format = formatter
	})
end

-- Basic
addStyle("Normal", function(t)
	return t
end)

addStyle("Spaced", function(t)
	local result = ""

	for _, code in utf8.codes(t) do
		result ..= utf8.char(code) .. " "
	end

	return result
end)

addStyle("Wide", function(t)
	local result = ""

	for _, code in utf8.codes(t) do
		local c = utf8.char(code)

		if c == " " then
			result ..= "  "
		else
			result ..= c .. " "
		end
	end

	return result
end)

local function clearList()
	for _,child in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
		if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function renderFonts(filter)
	clearList()

	local count = 0

	for index,style in ipairs(styles) do
		local matches =
			filter == ""
			or string.find(
				string.lower(style.Name),
				string.lower(filter),
				1,
				true
			)

		if matches then
			count += 1

			local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
			button.Size = UDim2.new(1,-5,0,30)

			-- IMPORTANT:
			-- Button itself uses normal Roblox font.
			-- No unsupported Unicode mathematical glyphs.
			button.Text = style.Name .. "  •  SHUBHAM"
			button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
			button.TextSize = 13
			button.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
			button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24,24,32)
			button.BorderSizePixel = 0
			button.Parent = scroll

			local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,8)
			corner.Parent = button

			button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				selectedStyle = style
				refreshPreview()
			end)
		end
	end

	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0,count * 35)
end

local function makeDraggable(object)
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart
	local startPosition

	object.InputBegan:Connect(function(inputObject)
		if inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
			dragStart = inputObject.Position
			startPosition = object.Position

			inputObject.Changed:Connect(function()
				if inputObject.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inputObject)
		if not dragging then
			return
		end

		if inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			local delta = inputObject.Position - dragStart

			object.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPosition.X.Scale,
				startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPosition.Y.Scale,
				startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)
end
